## Purpose and Runtime
Musify is a Flutter/Dart music-streaming Android application with search, playback, offline listening, playlists, radio, lyrics, imports, and listening statistics. The primary app runtime is Flutter; Android hosts it through `android/app/src/main/kotlin/com/gokadzev/musify/MainActivity.kt`. Distribution has normal and F-Droid-specific Dart entry points: `lib/main.dart` and `lib/main_fdroid.dart`.

## Application Bootstrap and Navigation
Startup assembles app-wide services, settings, theme/localization, and routes before presenting the navigation shell. `lib/screens/bottom_navigation_page.dart` is the main feature boundary between home, search, library, and player-oriented experiences. Routing is centralized rather than embedded exclusively in screens through `lib/services/router_service.dart`; app-level constants and service clients are defined in `lib/constants/app_constants.dart` and `lib/constants/clients.dart`.

## Content Discovery and Source Integration
Search, artist, playlist, and track metadata flow from UI screens through service layers and bundled source-client packages. `lib/screens/search_page.dart` and `lib/services/artist_service.dart` represent app-facing discovery flows. `packages/youtube_music_explode_dart/lib/src/music_client.dart` provides YouTube Music access, while `packages/youtube_explode_dart/lib/src/search/search_client.dart` and `packages/youtube_explode_dart/lib/src/videos/streams/stream_client.dart` fetch/search and resolve stream manifests from YouTube. This is an external-network boundary subject to upstream protocol changes and media availability.

## Playback, Queue, and Audio Boundaries
Playback state is modeled separately from UI and coordinated by an audio service: `lib/services/audio_service.dart`, `lib/models/full_player_state.dart`, and `lib/screens/now_playing_page.dart`. UI widgets such as `lib/widgets/mini_player.dart` and `lib/widgets/queue_list_view.dart` observe/control the shared playback and queue experience. Equalizer and playback controls remain screen-level consumers of this service boundary (`lib/screens/equalizer_page.dart`).

## Local Data, Offline Content, and User Library
Persistent user collections are separated into database-backed albums, playlists, and radio stations: `lib/database/albums.db.dart`, `lib/database/playlists.db.dart`, and `lib/database/radio_stations.db.dart`. `lib/services/data_manager.dart` handles broader application data lifecycle; `lib/services/playlists_manager.dart` manages playlist-domain operations. Offline playlist acquisition is mediated by `lib/services/playlist_download_service.dart`, isolating download/storage behavior from playlist UI.

## Supporting User Features
Lyrics, listening recaps, sharing, and external imports are service-oriented extensions around the core content/playback flow. Relevant boundaries are `lib/services/lyrics_manager.dart`, `lib/services/listening_stats_service.dart`, and `lib/services/playlist_sharing.dart`. Spotify import has a dedicated interaction surface in `lib/screens/import_spotify_playlist_page.dart`. Android/iOS share-intent handling comes from the included platform plugin at `packages/receive_sharing_intent/lib/receive_sharing_intent.dart`, with Android native integration in `packages/receive_sharing_intent/android/src/main/kotlin/com/kasem/receive_sharing_intent/ReceiveSharingIntentPlugin.kt`.

## Delivery and Platform Infrastructure
Android builds use Gradle Kotlin DSL (`android/app/build.gradle.kts`) and manifests under `android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`. GitHub Actions defines release, pre-release, and F-Droid pipelines in `.github/workflows/release.yml`, `.github/workflows/fdroid.yml`, and `.github/workflows/pre_fdroid.yml`. Store metadata and screenshots are maintained through Fastlane at `fastlane/metadata/android/en-US`.
